title: Greek Lentil Stew
description: A hearty and flavorful stew made with Greek lentils, perfect for a keto diet. This dish is packed with protein and fiber, and is sure to become a favorite.
instructions: Heat 2 tablespoons of oil in a large pot over medium heat.
Add the aromatic and cook until fragrant, about 1 minute.
Add the smoky and cook for an additional 2 minutes.
Add the stew and cook for 5 minutes, stirring occasionally.
Add the Greek lentils and 4 cups of water to the pot.
Bring the mixture to a boil, then reduce the heat to low and simmer for 20 minutes, or until the lentils are tender.
Season the stew with salt and pepper to taste.
Serve hot, garnished with fresh herbs if desired.
